title: Best Practices for your LinkedIn Profile Picture 📸
description:
The first item you want to add to your LinkedIn profile is a profile picture. This will likely be the first time a recruiter will see you so you want a professional looking headshot (for your industry) and smiling like you're having a good time. #linkedin #linkedinprofiletips #linkedinprofile
